name: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC)

conventions.compounding: Quarterly, credited to account (not paid out until maturity)
conventions.tenure: 2 years from date of each individual deposit
conventions.depositLimitCurrent: Min Rs 1,000 in multiples of Rs 100; max Rs 2,00,000 per account/across accounts per holder (3-month gap required between accounts)
conventions.withdrawal: Up to 40% of eligible balance permitted once after 1 year, before maturity
conventions.status: DISCONTINUED for new deposits from 2025-04-01 (DEA letter F.No.14/1/2019-NS-Part(1) dated 27.03.2025; India Post SB Order 03/2025 dated 28.03.2025). Existing accounts continue to maturity unaffected.
conventions.administeredBy: DEA / National Savings Institute; India Post and authorised banks

currentQuarter.period: N/A -- scheme closed to new deposits since 2025-04-01

periods.note: Only rate this scheme ever had -- fixed at 7.5% p.a. for its entire life, compounded quarterly and credited to the account (not paid out); set by Gazette notification G.S.R. 237(E) dated 31 Mar 2023 under the Government Savings Promotion Act 1873. Window for opening NEW accounts was 2023-04-01 to 2025-03-31; each account has its own independent 2-year maturity running from its opening date (so accounts opened in March 2025 mature March 2027).

gaps: None -- short-lived, single-rate scheme with clean primary documentation for both launch and discontinuation.
notes: Never revised: 7.5% was the rate at launch (Budget 2023 announcement) and remained so for the entire life of the scheme.
